title: Compact Horizon Panel - Route + Model Overview with Latency Synthesis
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, high-density overview panel (Horizon Panel) that surfaces combined per-route and per-model performance signals: latency distributions, throughput, token flow, and cost-synthesis. The panel must be embeddable in the Route list and Model details pages and support quick triage—filtering to percents, time ranges, and rollup levels.
background: Current model/route dashboards are full-page canvases with many drilldowns. Support engineers and PMs often need a compact, consistent summary across screens to decide whether to open full diagnostics. We want a reusable composable panel that aggregates key metrics into a single glanceable row/card.
goals: One-line summary card for route and model that fits in 1-2 rows of list/table views
Show latency SLO signal (p50, p95, p99) + latency change over time as a mini-sparkline
Expose throughput and tokens-per-request with simple arrows for directionality
Provide on-hover micro-trace and link to full model/route timeline
Enable quick comparisons between model variants or route versions within the same card
user_stories: As an on-call engineer, I want to scan a page of routes and see which ones exceed p95 latency SLO so I can prioritize incidents
As a PM, I want to compare the cost-per-1k-tokens across model variants for a route to decide a rollout plan
As an SRE, I want the horizon card to highlight recent regressions and let me jump to the detailed waterfall for that time window
acceptance_criteria: Card renders in route list and model details at 280px width without layout overflow
Displays p50/p95/p99 numeric badges plus a 60-point sparkline representing last 24h latency trend
Hover state shows a compact micro-trace and a link to the full performance canvas
Color system maps to severity buckets: normal/amber/red with accessible contrast
Keyboard accessible focus and screen-reader friendly labels for metric values
chart_specs: Latency sparkline: 24h window, 60 samples, area under the curve with overlaid p50/p95/p99 dotted lines; aggregation: sliding 5-min median for noisy distributions
Latency badges: numeric p50/p95/p99 showing latest value; unit in ms; p95 badge color based on thresholds defined by route SLO (green < SLO, amber 1-1.25x SLO, red > 1.25x SLO)
Throughput mini-bar: last 24h average RPS as condensed bar sparkline with peak marker; value shown as small integer under the sparkline
Tokens-per-request: concise value with delta vs previous period (▲/▼) and optional histogram preview on hover
Cost-synthesis strip: normalized cost-per-1000-tokens with micro-bars comparing active model variant vs fallback variants (100px max width), hover shows breakdown by batching/quantization
Interaction: brush select across sparkline to open the full timeline filtered to that interval; hover tooltips show timestamp, p50/p95/p99, RPS, tokens
Accessibility: alt text for charts generated from latest numeric snapshot, color palette meets WCAG AA for normal and high contrast themes
Data fallbacks: show skeleton states for missing metrics and an explicit 'metric unavailable' icon with link to ingestion diagnostics
component_specs: Card layout: 280px x 72px default, scalable to 320px wide; left column (40px) model/route tag + severity dot; middle (160px) sparkline + badges stacked; right (80px) throughput + tokens + cost microstrip
Typography: numeric badges use Inter Medium 12px; micro labels 10px; truncated route names with tooltip
States: normal, loading, stale (last ingest > 15m), error (ingest failure) with patterns and iconography guidelines
Animations: smooth 180ms ease for sparkline updates; avoid motion for reduced-motion users
tradeoffs: Density vs clarity: compressing three percentiles into a small badge reduces immediate readability; mitigated with hover and an optional expanded state
Metric sampling: using 60 samples reduces resolution but keeps card performant in lists; provide full-resolution in detailed view
Cost context: showing normalized cost rather than dollar amounts avoids currency conversions, but may be less actionable for finance teams
decisions: Choose percentiles p50/p95/p99 as the default displayed metrics because they match on-call diagnostic needs
Use normalized cost-per-1k-tokens for compactness; add explicit link to cost breakdown in the full console
Expose only a single primary CTA in the card: 'Open timeline' to keep the card lightweight

dependencies: ENG-79210 (backend): provide horizon-card aggregate endpoint with p50/p95/p99, rps, tokens, cost normalized
ENG-80533 (frontend): implement compact chart primitives and tooltip/brush interactions

risks: Over-aggregation may hide short spikes that are important for incident response; mitigated by hover micro-trace and quick link to detailed timeline
If backend TTL for aggregates is long, card may show stale values leading to mis-prioritization
Performance: rendering many cards in a long list could increase CPU on low-end laptops; implement virtualization and server-side sampling
